resolutions.researcher_notes: Brief flagged the existing youm7.com ref as DEAD_LINK, but re-verified now: 200 OK, contains 'ريفين' (Raven) and directly describes the 2023 inauguration ceremony for the Raven field gas connection pipelines -- confirms operating status. Corroborated independently by the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum's own 2022 year-in-review press release (petroleum.gov.eg), which states the Rashid-Ameriya 18-inch/5km line became operational in September 2022 (100 MMcfd to the Ameriya butane plant), consistent with 'operating' by the time of the July 2023 youm7 inauguration piece. Two independent origins (news outlet + official ministry site), neither tracing to GEM. No contradiction found.

youm7 states explicitly: 'وصلة بطول 5 كم وقطر 18 بوصة لنقل غازات حقل ريفين لمصنع بوتاجاز العامرية' (an 18-inch, 5 km line carrying Raven field gas to the Ameriya butane plant) -- exact match to LengthKnown=5.00 km. Note: the same article/project also references a separate, longer 70 km/30-inch trunk line from Rashid to the Western Desert gas complex (a different segment, not this ProjectID's value) -- flagging so it isn't confused with the 5 km Ameriya spur. petroleum.gov.eg independently corroborates the 5 km/18-inch Rashid-Ameriya spur ('خط بقطر 18 بوصة وطول 5 كم', operational Sept 2022, 100 MMcfd). Two independent origins agree on 5 km; no contradiction to the GEM value.

youm7 identifies the Raven field's gas as originating near Rashid ('حقل ريفين ... منطقة رشيد') with the 5 km/18-inch spur delivering to the Ameriya ('العامرية') butane plant, which sits in Alexandria governorate -- matches StartLocation=Rashid/Rashid and EndLocation=Ameriya/Alexandria. petroleum.gov.eg independently confirms gas from the Raven field near Rashid is piped to the Ameriya butane extraction facility. Two independent origins agree on both endpoints; no contradiction to the GEM value.
